title: Catalog and Inventory View gives read access to the catalog and inventory
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Parts Department ON and Catalog and Inventory View only.
custom_steps:
1. Open Catalog and Inventory.
  2. Browse catalog entries.
  3. View inventory levels.
  4. View part history.
custom_expected:
All of these views open.

There are no edit or delete options.
evidence: UI: a role with Catalog and Inventory View opens /parts/parts-catalogue and the catalogue renders (read access to the catalog).
